-----1.) BUSC vs BNKM: YTD ADB
SELECT TOP 10 * FROM 
        (SELECT A.ACID, A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE
        ,B.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, (A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL)*ISNULL(VAR_CRNCY_UNITS, 1.00)/(DATEPART(dayofyear, A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE)) AS YTDADB_BUSC
        ,B.ACID AS ACID_GAM, B.FORACID 
        FROM busc.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES A
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 and isActive = 1) B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE WHERE isLatest = 1 AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND RATECODE = 'REV' AND RTLIST_DATE = '2023-01-27') C ON C.FXD_CRNCY_CODE = B.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AND A.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
        WHERE A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = '2023-01-27') BUSC
    FULL OUTER JOIN
        (SELECT DISTINCT A.CustomerAccountId, A.PeriodEndDate, A.AccumulatedCurrentBalance
        ,B.IsoCurrencyCode, (A.AccumulatedCurrentBalance)*ISNULL(C.ConversionRate, 1.00)/(DATEPART(dayofyear, A.PeriodEndDate)) AS YTDADB_BNKM
        FROM bnkm.CasaTdAggregateBalance A
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') B ON B.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' AND CurrencyConversionTimestamp = '2023-01-27') C ON C.ConvertFromCurrencyId = B.IsoCurrencyCode AND C.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
        WHERE AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance' AND PeriodEndDate = '2023-01-27') BNKM 
            ON BUSC.FORACID = BNKM.CustomerAccountId
    WHERE (BNKM.CustomerAccountId IS NULL) AND BUSC.ACID IS NOT NULL) 
    AND BUSC.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL != BNKM.AccumulatedCurrentBalance

-----2.) BUSC vs BNKM: Dep Out Bal
SELECT sum(DepOutBal_BUSC) FROM 
        (SELECT A.ACID, A.TRAN_DATE_BAL, A.EOD_DATE, A.END_EOD_DATE
        ,B.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, ISNULL(VAR_CRNCY_UNITS, 1.00)*(A.TRAN_DATE_BAL) AS DepOutBal_BUSC
        ,B.ACID AS ACID_GAM, B.FORACID FROM busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE A
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 and isActive = 1) B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE WHERE isLatest = 1 AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND RATECODE = 'REV' AND RTLIST_DATE = '2023-01-27') C ON C.FXD_CRNCY_CODE = B.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AND C.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
        WHERE A.EOD_DATE <= '2023-01-27' AND A.END_EOD_DATE >= '2023-01-27') BUSC
    FULL OUTER JOIN
        (SELECT DISTINCT A.CustomerAccountId, A.PeriodStartDate, A.BalanceAmount
        ,B.IsoCurrencyCode, ISNULL(C.ConversionRate, 1.00)*A.BalanceAmount AS DepOutBal_BNKM
        FROM (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND PeriodStartDate <= '2023-01-27' AND PeriodEndDate >= '2023-01-27' AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') A
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') B ON B.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' AND CurrencyConversionTimestamp = '2023-01-27') C ON C.ConvertFromCurrencyId = B.IsoCurrencyCode AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
        ) BNKM 
            ON BUSC.FORACID = BNKM.CustomerAccountId
    WHERE (BNKM.CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL AND BUSC.ACID IS NOT NULL) 
    AND BUSC.TRAN_DATE_BAL != BNKM.BalanceAmount

        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' AND CurrencyConversionTimestamp = '2023-01-27') C ON C.ConvertFromCurrencyId = B.IsoCurrencyCode AND C.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId

SELECT ProductId, PeriodEndDate, FcbsApplication, SourceSystemCode, COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE CustomerAccountId IN (
SELECT CustomerAccountId FROM 
        (SELECT DISTINCT A.CustomerAccountId, A.PeriodEndDate, A.AccumulatedCurrentBalance
        ,B.IsoCurrencyCode, (A.AccumulatedCurrentBalance)*ISNULL(C.ConversionRate, 1.00)/(DATEPART(dayofyear, A.PeriodEndDate)) AS YTDADB_BNKM
        FROM bnkm.CasaTdAggregateBalance A
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') B ON B.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' AND CurrencyConversionTimestamp = '2023-01-27') C ON C.ConvertFromCurrencyId = B.IsoCurrencyCode AND C.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
        WHERE AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance' AND PeriodEndDate = '2023-01-27') BNKM 
    FULL OUTER JOIN
        (SELECT AccountID, AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull, BusinessDateSK
        FROM dw.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD_TEST_20231004
        WHERE BusinessDateSK = 20230127) DW
            ON BNKM.CustomerAccountId = DW.AccountID
    WHERE 
    (BNKM.CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL AND DW.AccountID IS NULL)
    )
    AND ProductId NOT LIKE '09%'
    GROUP BY ProductId, PeriodEndDate, FcbsApplication, SourceSystemCode ORDER BY ProductId DESC
    ---AND BNKM.YTDADB_BNKM != DW.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull
    AND ABS(BNKM.YTDADB_BNKM - DW.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull) > 1
